<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Handover" name="Order handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Tracking" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Feedback or return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics provider"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Order" name="Order placed" messageRef="Msg_Order"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Handover" name="Order handover" messageRef="Msg_Handover"
                      sourceRef="Task_Handover" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Tracking" name="Tracking information" messageRef="Msg_Tracking"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Feedback or return" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Company">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sales" name="Sales system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Merge_Monitor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Monitor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandleFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Handover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Order" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Order" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Handover" name="Hand over order to logistics provider" messageRef="Msg_Handover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Msg_Tracking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Monitor" name="Merge before monitoring" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Loop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Monitor" name="Monitor shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivered" name="Shipment delivered to customer address?" default="Flow_Loop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delivered</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Loop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Feedback or return received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleFeedback" name="Handle feedback or return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Feedback" name="Further actions completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Order" targetRef="Task_GenConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_GenConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_GenLabel" targetRef="Task_Handover"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Handover" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Monitor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Monitor" targetRef="Task_Monitor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_Monitor" targetRef="Gateway_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="End_Delivered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Shipment delivered to customer address</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Loop" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Monitor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="Task_HandleFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackEnd" sourceRef="Task_HandleFeedback" targetRef="End_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Logistics" name="Logistics provider" isExecutable="false"/>

  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" id="Diagram_Placeholder"/>
</bpmn:definitions>
